title: Implement ShoppingListDocument markdown parser
description: Implement tolerant line-based parsing from markdown into typed title, notes, meals, and aisle entries, including `## Other` handling and preservation of pre-aisle note blocks.
acceptance_criteria: `init(markdown:)` classifies the first H1 as title, `## Meals` bullets as meals, non-Meal `##` sections as aisles, and pre-aisle free text as notes.
Checklist entries are parsed into typed aisle items with checked state and raw text preserved.
Unmodelled content inside aisle sections is ignored for rendering purposes rather than represented as items.

handoff_summary.completed: init(markdown:) parser fully implemented: H1→title, ## Meals→meals, other ##→aisles, pre-aisle text→notes blocks. parseChecklistLine captures checked state and raw text. Non-checklist aisle content is dropped. Swift syntax check passes clean.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The fixture `shopping-list.md` contains a bare non-checklist bullet inside `## produce` (fruits line) and a lowercase `## other` section — both handled correctly by the existing implementation.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify parser behaviour against the shopping-list.md fixture and any additional edge-case inputs.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. ShoppingListDocument.swift is self-contained and no sibling beads claim the same file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Parser uses a simple linear state machine (pre / meals / aisle) rather than a recursive descent or regex approach, consistent with the spec's "tolerant line-based parsing" requirement. The flush() closure captures mutable state by reference, which is intentional for the nested-function pattern in Swift.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests exist yet for ShoppingListDocument.init(markdown:). The tester bead should cover: title extraction, meals list, aisle items with both checked states, pre-aisle note block preservation, non-checklist bullets inside aisles being dropped, and the lowercase ## other section.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Meals section only recognises plain bullet lines (- text); checklist-style lines inside ## Meals are silently ignored. This is intentional per the spec but may be surprising if a user hand-edits the file with checked meal items.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. ShoppingListDocument.swift is self-contained and no sibling beads claim the same file.

execution_history.summary: All three acceptance criteria for the markdown parser are fully satisfied by the implementation already committed in dependency bead B-36a590ee. The `init(markdown:)` in ShoppingListDocument.swift correctly classifies H1 as title, `## Meals` bullets as meals, other `##` sections as aisles, and pre-aisle free text as notes. Checklist entries are parsed into typed `ShoppingListEntry` values with checked state and raw text preserved. Non-checklist content inside aisle sections (e.g., the bare bullet `- fruits (mixed selection for the week)` in the fixture) is silently dropped. File passes `swiftc -parse` with no diagnostics. No code changes were needed in this bead.
